Do you have ui.R and server.R per http://shiny.rstudio.com/tutorial/lesson1/ ? Or just app.R?

On Tuesday, June 28, 2016 at 9:16:14 AM UTC-4, John Williams wrote:
## app.R ##
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(shiny)
library(networkD3)
library(ggplot2)
library(leaflet)
library(shinydashboard)

mrPUP <- read_csv("MrPUP.2014indexState.csv")
state_names <- read_csv("state_names.csv")
npi_names <- read_csv("npi_names.csv")

ui <- dashboardPage(
 
 dashboardHeader( title = "Medicare Analytics"),
  dashboardSidebar(

    selectInput('state1', 'Select Geographic Region', state_names$state.name, selectize = TRUE),
    radioButtons("procLev", h5("Select Procedure Level"), 
                 choices = list("I & II" = 1, "I only" = 2, "II only" = 3), selected = 1),
    radioButtons("npiType", h5("Select NPI Type"), 
                 choices = list("I & II" = 1, "I only" = 2, "II only" = 3), selected = 1),
    sliderInput("numDocs", h5("Select Number of Providers"), value = 7, min = 1, max = 60), 
    sliderInput("numProcs", h5("Select Number of Procedures"), value = 7, min = 1, max = 60), 
    submitButton(text = "Apply Changes", icon = NULL, width = NULL)
  ),
  
  dashboardBody(
 
    fluidRow(
      box(
        width = 12, status = "info", solidHeader = TRUE,
        title = "Medicare Provider Locations",
        leafletOutput("npiMap")
      )
    ),
    
    fluidRow(
      box(
        width = 6, status = "info", solidHeader = TRUE,
        title = "Top Providers",
        plotOutput("topDocs")
      ),
      box(
        width = 6, status = "info", solidHeader = TRUE,
        title = "Top Procedures",
        plotOutput("topProcs")
      )
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output) {
  
  filterData <- reactive({
    fun <- function() {
      mrPUP2 <- mrPUP      
      if (input$state1 != "All U.S. States")  { 
        selected_state <- state_names[which(state_names$state.name == input$state1), 2]$state.abbrev
        mrPUP2 <- mrPUP2 %>% filter(state == selected_state)
      }
      if (input$procLev != 1) {
        if (input$procLev == 2) mrPUP2 <- mrPUP2 %>% filter(procLevel == TRUE)
        if (input$procLev == 3) mrPUP2 <- mrPUP2 %>% filter(procLevel == FALSE)
      }
      return(mrPUP2)
    }    
  })
   
  getTopDocs <- reactive({
    fun <- function() {
      topDocs <- (filterData())() %>%
        group_by(npiFac) %>%
        summarise(nProcs = sum(nProc)) %>%
        arrange(desc(nProcs)) %>%
        head(n = input$numDocs)
      return(topDocs)
    }
  })

  getTopProcs <- reactive({
    fun <- function() {
      topProcs <- (filterData())() %>%
        group_by(hcpcsFac) %>%
        summarise(nProcs = sum(nProc)) %>%
        arrange(desc(nProcs)) %>%
        head(n = input$numProcs)
      return(topProcs)
    }
  })
   
  TDplot <- reactive({
    fun <- function() {
      p <- (getTopDocs())()  %>%
        ggplot(aes(x = reorder(npiFac, nProcs), y = nProcs)) +
        geom_bar(stat = 'identity') +
        coord_flip()
      return(p)
    }
  })

  TPplot <- reactive({
    fun <- function() {
      p <- (getTopProcs())() %>%
        ggplot(aes(x = reorder(hcpcsFac, nProcs), y = nProcs)) +
        geom_bar(stat = 'identity') +
        coord_flip()
      return(p)
    }
  })
  
  output$npiMap <- renderLeaflet({
    leaflet() %>%
      addTiles() %>%
      fitBounds(-127.44,24.05,-65.30,50.35) %>%
      addCircleMarkers(npi_names$lon,
                       npi_names$lat,
                       #                  color = npi_names$npiType,
                       radius = 3,
                       fill = F,
                       fillOpacity = 0.2,
                       opacity = 0.5,
                       popup = paste(npi_names$name,
                                     npi_names$addr1,
                                     npi_names$city,
                                     npi_names$state,
                                     npi_names$zip,
                                     sep = ", ")) # %>%

  })
    
  output$topDocs <- renderPlot({   (TDplot())()   }) 
  
  output$topProcs <- renderPlot({     (TPplot())()  })  

}

shinyApp(ui, server)
